items.title: Yiran on the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens: “It's Not a Tool; It's an Expression”
items.excerpt: Some lenses just have a personality, and the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 is one of them. Yiran took it out to the woods, the park, a small village – no fancy setups, just natural light. Here's what happened when she let this lens do its thing.

items.title: Poet-Photographer Satellite June on the Intersection Between Poetry & Analogue Photography
items.excerpt: Netherlands-based photographer and poet Satellite June takes us behind the scenes of her new book, where poetry meets analogue photography. It's an intimate look at the different layers of grief, and how film photography allowed her to bring those deeply personal emotions to light.

items.title: Half-Frame Stories with the Half-frame Simple Use Through the Lens of Guy (@dopamine.51)
items.excerpt: Shortly after the launch of the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera, Lomography Thailand sent the camera, preloaded with Lady Grey ISO 400 film, to Guy (dopamine.51) to put it to the test around Bangkok’s Old Town.

items.title: When Color Becomes Tool: Ishmael Claxton on His Methodical Use of LomoChrome Films
items.excerpt: 2026-08-21 #news#people![Image 4: When Color Becomes Tool: Ishmael Claxton on His Methodical Use of LomoChrome Films](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/357943-when-color-becomes-tool-ishmael-claxton-on-his-methodical-use-of-lomochrome-films) Dublin-based photographer Ishmael Claxton has been utilizing tones and hues from LomoChrome films to express ideas on race, identity, and meaning. He talks about his projects using these film stocks and the messages he conveys through them.

items.title: Two Days, Two Styles with Green (midori.pix) and the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: We chat with portrait photographer Green about his time with the Lomo MC-A and his experience shooting in completely different settings. He shares his impressions, creative process, and personal perspective on the camera after putting it to the test.

items.title: A Day With Weeraya Zhang and the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass
items.excerpt: We invited Wee Weeraya Zhang, former member of Thai girl group BNK48, to join us for this edition of A Day With.

items.title: Lo-Fi Portraits on Film: Laura Sales Meets the Diana F+
items.excerpt: Photographer Laura Sales shares her passion for analogue portraiture, and her lo-fi film experiments with the Diana F+. Discover her photos and her photographic vision in this interview.

items.title: Defying Sustainable Photography Limits: Exploring Martha Gray’s BioCyan Experiments
items.excerpt: What if there was an alternative photographic process which could truly be sustainable at its core? This area of exploration is where Martha Gray’s biomaterial-cyanotype prints and adjunct experiments reside.

items.title: First Impressions: Cassie McCoy's Backyard Pool Day with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: Carefree summer moments meet analogue creativity as Cassie McCoy shares her experience with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera, her creative process, and love for embracing imperfection.

items.title: Analogue Solo Trip: Alone in Muang Khon, Thailand
items.excerpt: This is a record of my first solo journey to Muang Khon, a city often overlooked by travelers. Through ancient temples, fascinating museums, historic streets, and film photography, I discovered a side of Nakhon Si Thammarat that made me fall in love with the province more than I expected.

items.title: In the Frame: Vibrant Neon Lights
items.excerpt: Our monthly photography prompt series, In the Frame, takes it to the neon-lit streets – electric hours captured in the way only film can.

items.title: Tiny Questions with the Lomomatic 110: Aimee France
items.excerpt: Tiny Questions with Aimee France: food, film, summer rituals, and everyday moments that reveal her creative world through the Lomomatic 110.

items.title: A Walk in the Peak District with Albert Cornelissen and the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: 2026-08-12 #news![Image 14: A Walk in the Peak District with Albert Cornelissen and the Lomo MC-A ](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358936-a-walk-in-the-peak-district-with-albert-cornelissen-and-the-lomo-mc-a) Curious photographer Albert Cornelissen broke in his brand new Lomo MC-A with a walk in the Peak District with a roll of Black & White film. We talked to Albert about his first impressions of this versatile new 35 mm camera.

items.title: Joel Byron on Filming Reggae duo The Tribulizations in Brighton with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Art Lens
items.excerpt: 2026-08-11 #news#people#videos![Image 15: Joel Byron on Filming Reggae duo The Tribulizations in Brighton with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Art Lens](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358163-joel-byron-on-filming-reggae-duo-the-tribulizations-in-brighton-with-the-joseph-petzval-55-focus-coupled-bokeh-control-art-lens) Brighton-based filmmaker Joel Byron from BigPlus Studio took the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens Art Lens to a gig with Reggae duo, The Tribulizations, and captured the fans dancing and enjoying themselves with a bit of bokeh thrown in the mix.

items.title: When in Rome: The Corners of the Eternal City with Ugo Leonetti and Johannes Beilharz
items.excerpt: Our new series invites shutterbugs to talk about their city – local culture, film and art scene, and more, now with Ugo (@Corinthian) and Johannes (@johbeil) in Rome.

items.title: A Day With Brian Hippern and the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass
items.excerpt: Seattle-based collage artist Brian Hippern shares a weekend of coffee, collecting found materials, and creating hand-cut collages, captured with the Lomo'Instant Automat Glass.

items.title: In Depth: A Grand Tour of Travel Photography
items.excerpt: For this In Depth piece, we will get into the early history of travel photography, from inspirations in painting to the use of portable cameras. Is it really true that what happens on vacation stays on vacation?

items.title: Levana Cynthia on Travel & Photography with the Petzval Art Lens
items.excerpt: We lent Indonesian photographer Levana Cynthia the Petzval Art Lens in time for her travel to India and the United States, and she sent back love stories photographed across grand landscapes and intimate moments.

items.title: Now & Then in London: To Be (in Frame) or Not To Be
items.excerpt: I took along a few old photos as inspiration for our next stop on the Now & Then tour: London. But in truly analogue fashion, nothing went according to plan.

items.title: Lomography Community Recap: July 2026
items.excerpt: Here’s your monthly dose of the latest happenings in the Lomography Community! Curious as to what your fellow Lomographers have been up to, or want the latest scoop on our ongoing Competitions? Find all this and more in our monthly recap!

items.title: Stage Photographer Martinus Ragita Dives into the World of Lomography
items.excerpt: Martinus Ragita is a professional Indonesian stage and concert photographer widely recognized in the local music industry for capturing the energy and raw atmosphere of live performances. In this interview, he shares his experience 35 mm Lomography films.

items.title: Analogue Journal: Slowing Down Through Analogue Art with Lin (linnpingg__)
items.excerpt: Step into Lin's (linnpingg__) simple yet inspiring world in this edition of Analogue Journal. Through instant photographs and her hand-painted Lomo'Instant camera, she shares her everyday life, favorite hobbies, and the little moments that bring her joy.

items.title: Finding the Best Film for the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: A Comparison of Lomography Film Stocks
items.excerpt: See how different Lomography films stocks work with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera and find the right roll for your creative style.

items.title: Back to the Rhythm of Photography with Tom (toms.portra) and the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: Get to know portrait photographer Tom (toms.portra) through his portraits with the Lomo MC-A 35 mm Film Camera, which he took on a stroll through lush parks and Japanese street-inspired settings.

items.title: Fashion Photographer Mario Giovanni's First Impressions of the Diana F+
items.excerpt: Indonesia-based professional visual storyteller Mario Giovanni has carved out a niche in the creative industry by blending high-end fashion aesthetics with emotional storytelling. We let him try out the Diana F+ to see his own twist on the creative camera.

items.title: Through Generations: Grandma Kinso & Granddaughter Yan-Han Preserve Native Language & Family Memories Through Storytelling
items.excerpt: Grandma Kinso and Yan-Han run the Instagram account “Grandma Kinso's Stories”, dedicated to passing down memories and their mother tongue. We invited this grandmother-granddaughter duo to share their stories that span multiple generations.

items.title: Collecting Mailbox Memories: Stories from the Lomographers’ Print Exchange
items.excerpt: Meet five Lomographers from Latvia, Spain, Italy, Brazil, and Argentina as they each share what they sent and received for the Lomographers' Print Exchange.

items.title: Recap: Birmingham Design Festival LomoWalk
items.excerpt: 2026-08-03 #people#places![Image 29: Recap: Birmingham Design Festival LomoWalk](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358672-recap-birmingham-design-festival-lomowalk) We brought a bit of Lomography magic to Birmingham Design Festival in the form of a LomoApparat LomoWalk complete with a mix of films and a lot of messing about. See some of the incredible results here and find out what participant Lauren Skillman had to say about the day.

items.title: New Kids: An Analogue Investigation of Contemporary Adolescence in Bologna by James Beghelli
items.excerpt: What happens when a photographer relinquishes control and allows teenagers to tell their own stories? In New Kids, James Beghelli gives Simple Use Cameras to young people in Bologna, turning film into a tool for exploration and self-expression.

items.title: Day vs Night: Testing the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Under Changing Light
items.excerpt: Lomography writers @francinegaebriele and @nate_soriano take the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera on a day-versus-night run to see how it captures the changing light throughout an entire day.
